meta.source: PostHog project 644121 remote POST /flags?v=2 vs probe-evaluator.ts; 8200/8200 values, reasons and condition indices matched
notes: expected = PostHog remote result (value: variant string | true | false; reason = reason.code; conditionIndex = reason.condition_index on condition_match).
specExpected = what the spec §4.4 evaluator returns for a registry entry with fallback false / variants[0]; holdout -> entry.fallback with reason holdout.
specUnsupported marks fixtures whose flag the §4.5 parser must mark unsupported; they still document PostHog semantics (missing property, non-trait operators).
timeRelative: tests must rebuild personProps.signup_date = now - N days before evaluating (is_date_* compare against now).
Integer traits are sent as JSON numbers, exactly as express will send them.
